EQ-10: DC resistance with temperature. rho_T = rho_20*(1 + alpha_20*(T - 20)); R_ph = sum rho_T*L_i/(w_i*t_i) + sum R_via + R_links (+ parallel combination per EQ-07)
EQ-11: Via barrel resistance. A = pi*(2*r*t_p - t_p^2), r = drill/2; R_via = rho_T*l/A; n vias in parallel -> R/n
EQ-07: Phase assembly, per-layer EMF, parallel paths and circulating loss. E_ph = sum_groups E_grp; E_grp = sum_i(E_i/R_i)/sum_i(1/R_i); R_grp = 1/sum_i(1/R_i); P_c = sum_i |E_i - E_grp|^2/(2*R_i) (peak phasors)
